plugins.description: Shared local memory for coding agents: recalls past sessions across 43 agents, cross-agent handoff, file blame and error-fix history over MCP.
Local-first, auditable cross-session project memory for Kimi Code with scoped recall, traceable provenance and approval-gated writes.
Let the agent capture live website screenshots and render HTML/CSS into images or PDFs without managing a browser.
Android development from Kimi Code: adb, emulators and devices, screenshots, UI automation, Gradle builds and tests, and Android Studio control via the JetBrains MCP server.
Computer Use on macOS: AX-tree with element refs, headless clicks, typing, scrolling, keys and screenshots through 21 MCP tools. Drop-in kimi-cu replacement.
Xcode from Kimi Code: builds, tests, SwiftUI previews, simulators and devices, build logs and Apple docs via Xcode's own MCP server (xcrun mcpbridge).
Chrome DevTools from Kimi Code: performance traces, network inspection, console, DOM debugging and screenshots against a live Chrome.
A battery of workflow skills — brainstorming, systematic debugging, TDD, planning — with Kimi tool-name remapping built in.
Vibecoding-first planning: interrogates the task, keeps specs and checklists honest before code gets written.
Extra TUI status-bar metrics for Kimi Code: tokens/sec, prompt-cache hit rate and plan usage windows.
Cuts redundant file reads and weak prompts using wire.jsonl ground truth — 63% measured token savings.
Security scanning of npm dependencies with NPMscan: vulnerabilities, malicious-code signals and upgrade advice.
Tencent CloudBase backend from Kimi Code: database, auth and cloud functions via plugin, skills and MCP.
Official Convex plugin: scaffold and build Convex + Next.js apps with a reactive, type-safe backend.
Neon serverless Postgres from your agent: schema design, database branching and SQL.
Official Remotion skills: programmatic video in React — animations, captions, audio and 3D.
Control Blender from Kimi Code: scene building, modeling and rendering over MCP (wraps blender-mcp).
Delegate from Kimi to OpenAI Codex: second-opinion reviews, custom prompts and parallel tasks.
Branch→PR→CI→review in one agent run: parallel review subagents, false-positive validation, severity reports, optional inline PR comments.
Guided 7-phase feature development (discovery → explore → clarify → architect → implement → review → summary) with specialized explorer, architect and reviewer agents.
Two-phase code simplification — pick the approach, then refine recent changes for clarity and consistency while preserving exact functionality.

Per-edit and per-commit security checks: 25 regex dangerous-pattern warnings, an OWASP vulnerability rubric on the session diff, and deep agentic commit review (injection, XSS, SSRF, secrets, IDOR, auth bypass).

Autonomous 'until all checks pass' development loops (Ralph Wiggum technique) in a single session: work a PRD/checklist, run the checks, self-restart iterations until the completion promise is genuinely true.

202 specialized subagents and 14 skills from wshobson/agents: backend/frontend dev, DevOps, QA, security, data engineering, ML ops, multi-agent teams — the whole Claude Code agent catalog in one plugin.
53 marketing skills: copywriting, SEO & AI-search visibility, paid ads, email, CRO, analytics & attribution, pricing, launches, competitor research, go-to-market strategy.

Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building or reshaping frontend UI: aesthetic direction, typography, palettes, layout, motion and copy that don't read as templated AI defaults.

Two answer-style personas: ponytail (lazy senior dev — smallest complete change, zero over-engineering) and caveman (maximum-terse replies that keep every technical fact), plus review/audit/debt skills.
